title: Onboard ceruleanx-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and automated changelog entry
author: Ava Chen
description: Onboard new open model ceruleanx-13b v1.0 into the model registry with canonical metadata, validated performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets, and an automated changelog entry so releases are surfaced to downstream consumers. Motivation: ceruleanx shows favorable quality/cost tradeoffs for mid-range latency SLOs and we want it available in Hosted and Dedicated pools. This PR includes: 1) models/ceruleanx-13b/metadata.json with model name, version, authors, license, tokenizer, parameter count, quantization compatibility tags, and recommended default runtime config; 2) models/ceruleanx-13b/perf_profiles.yaml covering p50/p95 latency and throughput for typical batch sizes and seq lengths derived from benchmark-lab runs; 3) tests/models/test_ceruleanx_profile.py integration tests validating profile format and basic inference smoke tests against the perf harness; 4) small update to the changelog generator to automatically pick up new model registry entries when a metadata "release_date" field is present; 5) docs/models/index.md entry; 6) CI workflow adjustment to run model onboarding smoke tests on PR. Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema validated and linted - [x] Perf profiles generated from controlled runs (benchmark-lab/2025-10-18) - [x] Unit and integration tests added and passing - [x] Changelog automation emits file to changelogs/ on merge - [x] Reviewed for sensitive data and license compatibility Testing notes: perf profiles were generated using the standard perf harness with quantization candidates disabled to get baseline FP16 numbers; p50=62ms, p95=118ms at batch=1 seq=512 on A100; throughput numbers and alternative quantized profiles included in perf_profiles.yaml. Migration/rollback: adding a registry entry is additive; rollback involves removing the metadata file and regenerating changelogs. No breaking changes to API surface. See linked Linear ENG-2121 for rollout plan and PM-544 for docs updates.
